about_the_game:
Carve through hordes of enemies and take down ferocious bosses. Upgrade and combine your skills, augment them with Overpowers, and uncover devastating synergies. Build a custom dash from modular elements and rearrange their order on the fly. Play the campaign and tackle quests solo or team up with a friend.

Demo content:

- Play the first run of the Tartarus domain — a guided introduction to the core mechanics.

- Face the first foe in our rogues' gallery of devious bosses: the Spectral Warden.

- Choose between two playable heroes: Achilles and Heracles. Full version will feature:

- 8 legendary heroes from Greek myth.

- 4 distinct domains, each with multiple runs packed with varied objectives and activities.

- A broader arsenal of abilities, more elements for synergies, and customization options for your hero’s dash.

- Deeper meta-progression and a full gear system to finely tune your build for each run. Your feedback on the demo is incredibly important to us and will help shape the future direction of the project.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: For 720p: Radeon R9 270, GeForce GTX 670 (Kepler architecture, driver 472.12+), Intel Iris Xe, or similar (with 2+ GB of VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes, please
  • VR Support: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: The red, cos the red goes fasta!
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: The biggest, the best, better than the rest.
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Absolutely
  • VR Support: No, too fancy
